claims.label: Summary
claims.explanation: The bill would require the commission to install and maintain air-quality monitors in counties that both contain a coal-fired electric generating facility and adjoin a county with a population of at least 3.3 million. It would also require real-time online access to monitor data and inclusion of the monitors in the commission’s annual monitoring network plan.
The bill creates air-quality monitoring requirements for specified counties, including monitoring ozone, fine particulate matter, and sulfur dioxide.
